dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: For each dimension n, this is the type of a vector norm together with an associated matrix norm satisfying the axioms supplied by D012.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The selected matrix norm defines the condition quantity κ in D009 and is used to define the scalar constants c1 and c8.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is a package of nonnegative dimension-dependent scalar and matrix-entry bounds, constructed as specified by D013.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It restricts the admissible constants package by placing dimension-dependent upper bounds on its scalars and nonnegative matrix entries.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: For each n, this is a package describing a complete iterative run: precision, unit roundoff, an invertible matrix, right-hand side and exact solution, solve models, iterates, computed residuals, corrections, and update errors, with the invariants in D019.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies A, Ainv, b, u, the iterate x_m, the correction d_m, and all run assumptions used in the proposition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects the third field of a run, namely its real unit-roundoff parameter u.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the factor u in the smallness hypothesis c8 u κ ≤ 1/2.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef005
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the constants package associated dependently with a run, norm package, and dimension-bound package; its complete data and constraints are given by D020.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies C2, C6, C7, C8, C9, C10, C11, C12 and c1, c5, c8, including the matrices and scalars defining the final bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef006
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects field 11 of the constants package, the scalar c8, which equals the matrix norm of C8.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the leading constant in the smallness assumption c8 u κ ≤ 1/2.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef007
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is a roundoff-error package for a fixed run and constants package, carrying residual-error and correction-error witnesses with the equations and bounds in D021.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Although no projection from it appears in the displayed conclusion, its existence assumes the detailed residual and correction roundoff model needed for the theorem.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef008
dependency_coverage.meaning: For iteration m, this is the vector A(x_m-d_m)-b, where x_m is the stored iterate and d_m is the stored correction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its ith component is the exact quantity whose absolute value is bounded in the conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef009
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is κ = matrixNorm(|A| |Ainv|), where absolute values are entrywise and multiplication is ordinary finite matrix multiplication.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the condition-like factor in the sole explicit smallness hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef010
dependency_coverage.meaning: For m, this is the vector B^m p+q, where B = u C8 |A| |Ainv|, p = u C10 |A| |x*|, and q is the three-term vector defined by D025.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its ith component is the explicit upper bound for |[A(x_m-d_m)-b]_i|.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef011
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects the matrix-norm component from a norm package.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It underlies every occurrence of matrixNorm, in particular κ, c1, and c8.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef012
dependency_coverage.meaning: This constructs a norm package from N and M. It requires N(x) ≥ 0; N(x)=0 iff x=0; the triangle inequality; N(ax)=|a|N(x); N(|x|)=N(x); componentwise absolute-value monotonicity; N(e_j)=1; M(A) ≥ 0; N(Ax) ≤ M(A)N(x); and minimality of M(A) among nonnegative constants having that operator-bound property.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: These assumptions make M the induced matrix norm used in κ and ensure its nonnegativity and compatibility with componentwise estimates.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef013
dependency_coverage.meaning: This constructs dimension bounds from functions scalar(k) and matrixEntry(k), both nonnegative for every natural k.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For the selected n, these functions upper-bound c1, c5, c8 and every entry of C1, C2, C6, C7, C8, C9, C10, C11, and C12.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef014
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects field 6 of a run, its n-by-n matrix A.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: A defines the linear system, the condition quantity, all error formulas, and the residual in the conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef015
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects field 7 of a run, the n-by-n matrix Ainv.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The run assumptions make it a two-sided inverse of A, and its entrywise absolute value occurs in κ and the bound matrices.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef016
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects field 10 of a run, the right-hand-side vector b.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It appears in the exact system Ax*=b and in the residual A(x_m-d_m)-b.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef017
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects field 18 of a run, the correction sequence d_m.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The conclusion bounds the residual formed after subtracting d_m from x_m.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef018
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects field 16 of a run, the iterate sequence x_m.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The conclusion and roundoff assumptions are stated at every iterate x_m.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef019
dependency_coverage.meaning: This constructs a run under 0<n, u>0, and n u≤1/100; two-sided inverse identities Ainv A=I and A Ainv=I; Ax*=b; entrywise nonnegativity of C1; a modeled initial solve; x_0=0, x_1 equal to its output, computedResidual_0=-b, and d_0=-x_1; modeled correction solves for computedResidual_{m+1}; and updates x_{m+1}=x_m-d_m+e_{m+1} with |e_{m+1,i}|≤u|x_{m,i}-d_{m,i}|.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It encodes all structural assumptions on the iterative process, including positive dimension, nonsingularity, exact solution, solve behavior, initialization, and update rounding.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef020
dependency_coverage.meaning: This constructs the constants package. With G=|A||Ainv|, it sets c1=M(C1), defines c5 and C2,C6,C7,C8,c8,C9,C10 by exact formulas, supplies two-sided inverses of I-u C1 G and I-u C8 G, defines C11 and C12 from the latter inverse and also requires their fixed-point equations, requires C2,C6,C7,C8,C9,C10,C11,C12 entrywise nonnegative, requires 0≤c1≤c8 and 0≤c8, and imposes all dimension bounds.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It provides the exact matrices and scalar c8 from which the contraction matrix B, vectors p and q, and the smallness hypothesis are formed.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef021
dependency_coverage.meaning: This constructs the roundoff package from residual errors r_m and correction errors s_m. It requires computedResidual_m=A x_m-b+r_m and the stated componentwise bound on r_m; A d_m=computedResidual_m+s_m; and, conditionally on c1 u κ≤1/2, the stated componentwise bound on s_m involving C2, |A|, |Ainv|, |x_m-x*|, and |r_m|.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the detailed real-valued rounding-error model assumed by the proposition; its witnesses are inputs, not quantities produced by the conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef022
dependency_coverage.meaning: This maps a matrix A to its entrywise absolute-value matrix, with entry |A_ij|.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines |A| and |Ainv| throughout κ, the constants, roundoff estimates, and the final bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef023
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the vector p = u (C10 |A|) |x*|.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the vector propagated by B^m in the final upper bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef024
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the matrix B = u C8 (|A| |Ainv|).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its mth power is the iteration-dependent factor in the final bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef025
dependency_coverage.meaning: With ubar equal to u or u^2 according to precision, this is q = n ubar |A||x*| + u^2 (C11|A|)|x*| + ubar u ((C12(|A||Ainv|))|A|)|x*|.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the iteration-independent additive vector in the final bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef026
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is ordinary n-by-n real matrix multiplication: (AB)_ij = Σ_k A_ik B_kj.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines the exact order and association of all matrix products in κ, the constants, the error bounds, and B^m p+q.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef027
dependency_coverage.meaning: This defines natural matrix powers recursively by B^0=I and B^(k+1)=B B^k.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Applied to B from D024, it supplies the exact B^m in the right-hand side.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef028
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is matrix-vector multiplication: (Ax)_i = Σ_j A_ij x_j.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets the linear system, residuals, error estimates, and all vectors appearing in the conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef029
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is componentwise vector addition.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms error decompositions, iterative updates, q, and the final vector B^m p+q.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef030
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is componentwise vector subtraction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms x_m-d_m, x_m-x*, A(x_m-d_m)-b, and other residual expressions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef031
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the type of a modeled solve of Ay=rhs with coefficient-bound matrix C1 and roundoff u; its data and backward-error property are supplied by D059.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Run construction assumes one initial modeled solve and a modeled correction solve at each later residual.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef032
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects the output vector y from a modeled solve.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It identifies x_1 with the initial solve output and each d_{m+1} with a correction-solve output.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef033
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects the matrix-entry bound function from the dimension-bound package.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its value at n bounds every entry of the nonnegative constant matrices.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef034
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects the scalar bound function from the dimension-bound package.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its value at n bounds c1, c5, and c8.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef035
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects field 13 of a run, the nonnegative matrix C1 used in the backward-error solve model.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines c1, the first resolvent, and the conditional correction-error smallness condition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef036
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects field 17 of a run, the computed-residual sequence.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is related to A x_m-b by residual error and serves as the right-hand side for correction solves.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef037
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects field 11 of a run, the exact-solution vector x*.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It satisfies Ax*=b and appears throughout the residual-error and final-bound vectors.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef038
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects the two-valued precision choice from a run.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines γ, the auxiliary precision term, and ubar, thereby changing c5 and the final bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef039
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects C10 from the constants package.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: C10 occurs in p = u C10 |A| |x*|.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef040
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects C11 from the constants package.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: C11 supplies the coefficient of the u^2 term in q.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef041
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects C12 from the constants package.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: C12 supplies the coefficient of the ubar u term in q.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef042
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects C2 from the constants package.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: C2 appears in the correction-error bound and in the recursive definitions of later constant matrices.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef043
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects C8 from the constants package.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: C8 defines c8, the second resolvent, and B=u C8|A||Ainv|.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef044
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects c1 from the constants package; c1 equals the matrix norm of C1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It occurs in the conditional correction-error estimate and satisfies 0≤c1≤c8.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef045
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects the scalar c5 from the constants package.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It appears in the residual-error estimate and in the formula defining C6.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef046
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is a two-element precision type, with the single and double cases supplied by D061 and D060 respectively.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The selected case controls the piecewise definitions of γ, the auxiliary term, and ubar.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef047
dependency_coverage.meaning: This maps a vector x to its componentwise absolute-value vector |x|.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is used in norm axioms, solve bounds, residual-error bounds, correction-error bounds, and p and q.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef048
dependency_coverage.meaning: For index j, this is the coordinate vector e_j whose ith entry is 1 when i=j and 0 otherwise.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The vector norm package requires N(e_j)=1, fixing coordinate normalization used by componentwise bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef049
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the n-by-n identity matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the zero-th matrix power and appears in all inverse, resolvent, and constant formulas.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef050
dependency_coverage.meaning: This defines γ piecewise. In single precision, γ=(1+u)((1+u)^n-1)/u^2-n/u. In double precision, γ=(1+u)(1+u^2)((1+u^2)^n-1)/u^2-n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: γ enters c5, C7, C9, C10, and the residual-error coefficient.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef051
dependency_coverage.meaning: This defines an auxiliary precision-dependent scalar η, equal to 0 in single precision and 1+u in double precision.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: η appears only through c5 = n+(γ+η)u^2/ubar.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef052
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is componentwise matrix addition.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms C6, C9, C10, C12 source terms, and the fixed-point equations.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef053
dependency_coverage.meaning: This predicate says that every entry of a matrix is nonnegative.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is imposed on C1 by the run package and on C2,C6,C7,C8,C9,C10,C11,C12 by the constants package.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef054
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is a zero-versus-successor eliminator for natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It implements the base and successor branches in the recursive definition B^0=I and B^(k+1)=B B^k.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef055
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is scalar multiplication of a matrix, entry by entry.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms all scalar-weighted matrices in the resolvents, constants, B, and q.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef056
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is componentwise matrix subtraction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms the resolvent matrices I-u C1 G and I-u C8 G.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef057
dependency_coverage.meaning: This defines ubar piecewise as u in single precision and u^2 in double precision.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It appears in c5, C6, C7, C10, the residual-error bound, and two terms of q.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef058
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is scalar multiplication of a vector, component by component.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It applies the coefficients u, u^2, n ubar, and ubar u in p, q, and the error estimates.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef059
dependency_coverage.meaning: This constructs a modeled solve with output y and backward error δ satisfying Ay=rhs+δ and |δ_i|≤u[C1(|A||y|)]_i for every i.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the exact semantics of the initial solve and every correction solve assumed in the run.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef060
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the double-precision constructor of the two-valued precision type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: In this case ubar=u^2, η=1+u, and γ uses the double-precision formula.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef061
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the single-precision constructor of the two-valued precision type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: In this case ubar=u, η=0, and γ uses the single-precision formula.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef062
dependency_coverage.meaning: This eliminates the precision type by choosing its first branch at D061 and its second branch at D060.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It implements all precision-dependent scalar definitions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef063
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the same two-case precision eliminator expressed through the recursor D065, with arguments ordered as single then double.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It connects the branch definitions in D062 to the two precision constructors.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef064
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is absolute matrix-vector multiplication: its ith entry is Σ_j |A_ij||x_j|, equivalently (|A||x|)_i.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the nonnegative magnitude vector used in each modeled solve's backward-error bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef065
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the recursor for the two-constructor precision type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It justifies exhaustive single-versus-double definitions with no additional precision cases.

dependency_coverage.name: DivInvMonoid.toDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: This extracts division from a division-and-inversion monoid structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For real numbers it supplies ordinary division, including 1/2 and the quotients in γ and the constant formulas.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin
dependency_coverage.meaning: Fin n is the finite index type consisting of natural indices strictly below n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It indexes all n-vectors and n-by-n matrices and is the domain of the universally quantified component i.

dependency_coverage.name: HDiv.hDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: This invokes heterogeneous division from the applicable HDiv instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Here it denotes ordinary real division in 1/2 and all displayed scalar formulas.

dependency_coverage.name: HMul.hMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: This invokes heterogeneous multiplication from the applicable HMul instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Here it denotes ordinary real multiplication, including c8 u κ and scalar coefficients.

dependency_coverage.name: LE.le
dependency_coverage.meaning: This invokes the less-than-or-equal relation supplied for a type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For real numbers it interprets every nonnegativity, upper-bound, smallness, and final componentwise inequality.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the type of natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the dimension n, iteration index m, exponent indices, and dimension casts.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.instAtLeastTwoHAddOfNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: This proves that n+1 is at least two when n is nonzero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: At n=1 it supports elaboration of the natural literal 2 used to construct the real denominator 2.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.instNeZeroSucc
dependency_coverage.meaning: This proves that every natural successor is nonzero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the nonzero premise used while elaborating the numeral 2.

dependency_coverage.name: OfNat.ofNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: This interprets a natural numeral in a type with the corresponding OfNat instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the real numerals 1 and 2 and natural literals used throughout the definitions.

dependency_coverage.name: One.toOfNat1
dependency_coverage.meaning: This derives the interpretation of numeral 1 from a type's multiplicative identity.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the real numerator 1 in 1/2 and other occurrences of 1.

dependency_coverage.name: Real
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the mathematical type of real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All matrix entries, vector entries, norms, constants, errors, and inequalities in the proposition are over the reals.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: This supplies the additive-group structure of the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports real negation, subtraction, and the definition of absolute value.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instDivInvMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: This supplies real multiplication, inversion, and division as a division-and-inversion monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes 1/2 and all real quotients in the precision and constants formulas ordinary real quotients.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLE
dependency_coverage.meaning: This supplies the usual order relation ≤ on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the standard mathematical meaning to the smallness assumption and final error bound.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: This supplies ordinary multiplication on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets all products of scalar constants and matrix or vector entries.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instNatCast
dependency_coverage.meaning: This supplies the canonical embedding of natural numbers into the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets n as a real scalar in n u, c5, C7, C10, and q.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instOne
dependency_coverage.meaning: This supplies the real multiplicative identity 1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is used in 1/2, identity-matrix entries, and the formulas containing 1+u.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.lattice
dependency_coverage.meaning: This supplies the lattice order structure of the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Together with the additive group, it makes abs the usual real absolute value.

dependency_coverage.name: abs
dependency_coverage.meaning: In an ordered additive group, abs(a)=max(a,-a); for reals this is the usual absolute value.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It measures the target residual component and defines all componentwise magnitude matrices, vectors, and error bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: instHDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: This lifts a homogeneous division operation to an HDiv instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It routes every real division expression to ordinary real division.

dependency_coverage.name: instHMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: This lifts a homogeneous multiplication operation to an HMul instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It routes every real scalar product to ordinary real multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatAtLeastTwo
dependency_coverage.meaning: This interprets a natural numeral at least two through a type's natural-number cast.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets the literal 2 as the real number 2 in the denominator of 1/2.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: This interprets each natural numeral as itself in Nat.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies natural literals such as 0, 1, and 2 during elaboration.

dependency_coverage.name: Eq
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is propositional equality.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses all exact inverse identities, system equations, recurrences, definitions stored as fields, and norm definiteness assumptions.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.fintype
dependency_coverage.meaning: This gives Fin n its canonical finite enumeration.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It permits the finite sums defining matrix multiplication and matrix-vector multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.sum
dependency_coverage.meaning: This sums a function over a finite set in an additive commutative monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Over all indices of Fin n, it defines the ordinary finite sums in matrix and matrix-vector products.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.univ
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the finite set of all elements of a finite type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For Fin n it makes each product sum range over every index from 0 through n-1.

dependency_coverage.name: HAdd.hAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: This invokes heterogeneous addition from the applicable HAdd instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It denotes ordinary addition on reals and natural numbers in vector, matrix, coefficient, and successor expressions.

dependency_coverage.name: HPow.hPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: This invokes exponentiation from the applicable HPow instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It denotes real natural powers such as u^2, (1+u)^n, and (1+u^2)^n.

dependency_coverage.name: HSub.hSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: This invokes heterogeneous subtraction from the applicable HSub instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It denotes ordinary real subtraction in residuals, errors, resolvents, and γ.

dependency_coverage.name: Iff
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is logical equivalence.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses the vector norm's definiteness axiom N(x)=0 iff x=0.

dependency_coverage.name: LT.lt
dependency_coverage.meaning: This invokes the strict-order relation supplied for a type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses 0<n and 0<u in the run assumptions.

dependency_coverage.name: Monoid.toNatPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: This supplies natural-number exponentiation in a monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For real numbers it defines the powers occurring in γ and u^2.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.below
dependency_coverage.meaning: This packages the values at smaller natural indices used by course-of-values recursion.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It provides the preceding matrix power needed to define B^(k+1)=B B^k.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.brecOn
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is course-of-values recursion on natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It implements the recursively defined natural matrix power in D027.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.cast
dependency_coverage.meaning: This applies the canonical natural-number cast into a target type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It turns n into the corresponding real coefficient wherever dimension appears arithmetically.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.succ
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the natural-number successor operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It underlies iteration indices m+1 and the successor recursion defining matrix powers.

dependency_coverage.name: Neg.neg
dependency_coverage.meaning: This invokes unary negation from the applicable Neg instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines computedResidual_0=-b, d_0=-x_1, and real absolute value through max(a,-a).

dependency_coverage.name: Pi.instZero
dependency_coverage.meaning: This gives a function type the pointwise zero function.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets x_0=0 and other zero-vector occurrences componentwise.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: This supplies ordinary addition on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets componentwise vector and matrix sums and scalar coefficient sums.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddCommMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: This supplies the additive commutative monoid structure of the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes the finite sums in all matrix and matrix-vector products well-defined.

binders: A dimension-bound package consisting of functions s,d : Nat → Real, where s bounds scalars and d bounds matrix entries.
A run package in dimension n, supplying a precision choice, u, A, Ainv, b, exact solution x*, C1, solve witnesses, iterates x_m, computed residuals rho_m, corrections d_m, and update errors.
A vector norm N on Real^n and its associated matrix norm M.
A constants package supplying C2,C6,C7,C8,C9,C10,C11,C12 and c1,c5,c8 together with inverse witnesses and all defining properties.
A roundoff package supplying residual-error witnesses r_m and correction-error witnesses s_m with their equations and bounds.
After the smallness assumption, an arbitrary natural iteration m and arbitrary component index i in Fin n.
hypotheses: The run satisfies 0<n, u>0, and n u≤1/100.
A and Ainv are n-by-n real matrices satisfying Ainv A=I and A Ainv=I, and the exact solution satisfies A x*=b.
C1 is entrywise nonnegative. A modeled solve of Ay=rhs with output y has a backward error delta satisfying Ay=rhs+delta and |delta_i|≤u[C1(|A||y|)]_i.
The initial solve is a modeled solve for rhs b; x_0=0, x_1 is its output, rho_0=-b, and d_0=-x_1.
For every m, d_(m+1) is the output of a modeled solve with right-hand side rho_(m+1). There are update errors e_(m+1) such that x_(m+1)=x_m-d_m+e_(m+1) and |e_(m+1,i)|≤u|x_(m,i)-d_(m,i)|.

N is nonnegative and definite, satisfies the triangle inequality and absolute homogeneity, is unchanged by taking componentwise absolute values, is monotone under componentwise domination of absolute values, and satisfies N(e_j)=1.
M is nonnegative, satisfies N(Ax)≤M(A)N(x), and is no larger than every nonnegative scalar c satisfying N(Ax)≤cN(x) for all x.
The dimension-bound functions s and d are nonnegative at every natural argument.
Let G=|A||Ainv| and κ=M(G). The constants satisfy c1=M(C1), c8=M(C8), 0≤c1≤c8, and 0≤c8.
The constants package contains two-sided inverse witnesses Q2 and Q11 for I-u C1 G and I-u C8 G respectively, and all exact constant formulas listed under mathematical_definitions.
C2,C6,C7,C8,C9,C10,C11,C12 are entrywise nonnegative. Every entry of C1 and these eight matrices is at most d(n), and c1,c5,c8 are at most s(n).
For every m, rho_m=A x_m-b+r_m and |r_(m,i)|≤(n ubar+gamma u^2)(|A||x*|)_i+c5 ubar(|A||x_m-x*|)_i+u|[A(x_m-x*)]_i|.
For every m, A d_m=rho_m+s_m. If c1 u κ≤1/2, then |s_(m,i)|≤u[(C2|A|)|x_m-x*|]_i+u[((C2|A|)|Ainv|)|r_m|]_i.
The explicit theorem assumption is c8 u κ≤1/2.
conclusions: For every natural m and every i in Fin n, |[A(x_m-d_m)-b]_i|≤[B^m p+q]_i.
Here B^0=I and B^(m+1)=B B^m, so the conclusion is a componentwise absolute residual bound at every iteration.
mathematical_definitions: All vectors are functions Fin n→Real and all matrices are functions Fin n→Fin n→Real. Matrix and matrix-vector products use finite sums over Fin n; vector and matrix addition, subtraction, absolute value, and scalar multiplication are componentwise.

The precision choice has two cases. Define ubar=u, eta=0, and gamma=(1+u)((1+u)^n-1)/u^2-n/u in the single case. Define ubar=u^2, eta=1+u, and gamma=(1+u)(1+u^2)((1+u^2)^n-1)/u^2-n in the double case.
Let Q2 be a two-sided inverse of I-u C1 G. Then C2=Q2 C1.
Let Q11 be a two-sided inverse of I-u C8 G. Then C11=Q11 C9 and C12=Q11(n C8+C7). The package additionally requires C11=C9+(u C8 G)C11 and C12=n C8+C7+(u C8 G)C12.
Define B=u C8 G and p=u(C10|A|)|x*|.
Define B^0=I and B^(m+1)=B B^m. The right-hand side in component i is [B^m p+q]_i.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every positive-dimensional iterative run and every compatible norm, bounded constants package, and roundoff-error package satisfying all of the stated exact inverse, solve, recurrence, nonnegativity, dimension-bound, and componentwise rounding-error conditions, if c8 times the unit roundoff u times κ=M(|A||Ainv|) is at most one half, then at every iteration m and component i the exact residual obtained after subtracting the stored correction from the current iterate satisfies |[A(x_m-d_m)-b]_i|≤[B^m p+q]_i, with B, p, and q given by the explicit formulas above.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: Although n is syntactically quantified over all natural numbers, a run contains a proof that 0<n. Thus no run can exist at n=0; the outer implication is vacuous there rather than yielding a substantive zero-dimensional result.

The theorem is conditional on the existence of highly structured run, norm, constants, and roundoff packages. It does not prove that such packages or the required resolvent inverses exist for arbitrary A or u.
The conclusion is itself conditional on c8 u κ≤1/2; when this fails, the proposition makes no assertion.

The correction-error estimate stored in the roundoff package is conditional on the weaker-looking antecedent c1 u κ≤1/2. The package relation 0≤c1≤c8, together with u>0 and κ≥0, allows the theorem's c8 smallness condition to imply this antecedent.
All quantities and error witnesses are real-valued. No floating-point datatype, executable rounding operation, overflow, underflow, exceptional value, or representability condition is encoded.

The matrix-entry dimension bounds are syntactically one-sided bounds on entries, not bounds on their absolute values. The relevant constant matrices are separately required to be entrywise nonnegative.
The result is componentwise and bounds the absolute value of A(x_m-d_m)-b. It does not directly bound a norm of this residual, the forward error x_m-x*, or a relative error.
The proposition does not assert convergence, decay of B^m, spectral-radius control, sharpness, or that the bound tends to zero.
The roundoff and inverse witnesses are assumptions carried by input packages, not existential witnesses produced by the theorem.
The matrix A is restricted to be exactly invertible over the reals because Ainv is required to be a two-sided inverse.
The initialization and sign conventions are exactly x_0=0, rho_0=-b, and d_0=-x_1; no alternative conventional residual sign is encoded.
